trigger: A different thread invokes release on the same FileLock instance already held by another thread, including reentrant depth2.
finding: Counters/native handle may be mutated before gate.release rejects non-owner, preventing legitimate owner cleanup. Normal correctly-owned execution is not demonstrated affected.
planned_fix: Validate gate ownership before acquisition/depth/handle mutation, retaining same native locking, FIFO order, deadlines and reentrancy.
qualification_boundary: Current392-input preflight finishes source2489 unchanged. Fix then receives its own freeze, source-bound qualification and full rounds; no historical timing/holder explanation or acceptance credit.
